metadata.title: Dubrulle, McGrew & Pourquie (2001) Cell / Dubrulle & Pourquie (2004) Nature — FGF8 mRNA Decay Advection-Reaction Wavefront & Determination Front Positioning in Vertebrate Somitogenesis

sources.citation: Dubrulle J, McGrew MJ, Pourquie O (2001). FGF signaling controls somite boundary position and regulates segmentation clock control of spatiotemporal Hox gene activation. Cell 106(2):219-232.
Dubrulle J, Pourquie O (2004). fgf8 mRNA decay establishes a gradient that couples axial elongation to patterning in the vertebrate embryo. Nature 427(6973):419-422.
Baker RE, Schnell S, Maini PK (2006). A clock and wavefront mechanism for somite formation. Developmental Biology 293(1):116-126.

Goldbeter A, Gonze D, Pourquie O (2007). Sharp developmental thresholds defined through bistability by antagonistic gradients of retinoic acid and FGF signaling. Developmental Dynamics 236(6):1495-1508.

chick_somite_psm_specimen.species: Gallus gallus (chick embryo dorsal SEM showing presomitic mesoderm, determination front transition, central neural tube, and bilateral segmented somite rows)

dubrulle_pourquie_2001_2004_governing_eq.section: Dubrulle et al. (2001) Cell 106:219-232 & Dubrulle & Pourquie (2004) Nature 427:419-422
dubrulle_pourquie_2001_2004_governing_eq.advection_decay_pde: dm/dt + v_g * dm/dx = -k_d * m  (in tailbud co-moving frame x >= 0)
dubrulle_pourquie_2001_2004_governing_eq.steady_exponential_profile: m(x) = m_0 * exp(-k_d * x / v_g) = m_0 * exp(-x / lambda_m),  where lambda_m = v_g / k_d
dubrulle_pourquie_2001_2004_governing_eq.lab_frame_somite_size_law: S_0 = v_f * T_c,  where v_f = v_g - dx_star/dt; at steady tailbud elongation v_f = v_g => S_0 = v_g * T_c

canonical_chick_psm_parameters.species: Gallus gallus (2-day HH10-12 chick embryo presomitic mesoderm)

dubrulle_2001_experimental_perturbations.source: Dubrulle, McGrew & Pourquie (2001) Cell 106:219-232 Figs. 1-4 & Dubrulle & Pourquie (2004) Nature 427:419-422 Figs. 1-3

regimes.label: Control wild-type chick PSM (endogenous fgf8 mRNA decay gradient)
Ectopic FGF8-soaked bead graft in mid-PSM (anterior to bead: wavefront retarded)
Ectopic FGF8-soaked bead graft cleared (posterior to bead: wavefront accelerated catch-up)
SU5402 pharmacological FGFR1 inhibition (posterior shift of determination front -> large somites)
Chick PSM pCAGGS-FGF8 electroporation (elevated m_0 = 1.6x -> anterior shift of x*)
